Pitcher

Bishop

harbor
seal

on
sandy
beaches

Gulf

He
reported
" strong
gregariousness "

among
seals
yet

little

structure
as
the
sexes
and
ages
were

He
did

size
and

spatially
static

On
the
other
hand ,
Scheffer

Slipp

on

This
study

not

Instead ,
it

that

Then ,
working

the
social

organization

dictates

age
class

out .
This
appears
to
be

especially
true
when
the
substrate
being
used
for
haul
out
is
irregularly
shaped

rocks ,

substrate
physical
features
may
not
be
as
important
a
factor
for
other

substrates
( i.e.
beaches ,
sandbars ,
mudflats ) .
This
study
does
not
discredit
the

presence
nor
the
importance
of
social
structure
within
harbor
seal
populations .

Rather ,
it
illustrates
the
need
to
consider
the
physical
features
of
potential
hauling

grounds

drawing
conclusions

the
significance
of
social
organization

a
population .
